title: suites.json
description: The path-to-suite map read by factory/bin/suites.sh (WO-20261013-f1ff): which test commands a pull request's changed files make necessary. A path maps to every suite that exercises it, not only the suite under it.

commands.description: Suite name to the one command that runs it, from the repository root. Every command must exist (pinned by factory/tests/cases/19-suites-map.test.sh).

always.description: Suite names planned for every diff, even an empty one.

full.description: The full set, in the order a plan prints commands. A plan is always printed in this order.

paths.description: Bash globs where * also crosses /; a bare directory or a trailing / is its subtree. No leading / and no .. segment.

suites.description: Suite names this path exercises, on top of always. An empty list means the path needs only the always set.

rows.description: A changed path plans the union of the suites of every row it matches. A path no row matches plans the full set.
